Name: Pokeplush - Pokemon Plushies Furniture Decoration
Author: bataranarada
Description:
Add your favorite Pokemon as plushies on your farm!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B4Gxjpv.jpeg[/img]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]

[size=4][b]How to Install:[/b][/size]
1. Make sure you installed all the requirements above.
2. Extract the file to the "Mods" folder. Your mods folder structure should be something like this "...\Stardew Valley\Mods\(AT) Pokeplush\".
3. Enjoy :D

[size=4][b]How to Get Your Plushies:[/b][/size]
1. Place the original item to the desired spot.
2. Use "Paint Bucket Tool" to that item. (You can buy it from Robin's shop)
3. Select your desired Pokemon.
